entries.e9aa6f5cfa8e464f: Under the management philosophy of "aiming to be a company trusted by the local community," the company is advancing the "Hiroshima Gas Group 2030 Vision" and the "Hiroshima Gas Group Medium-Term Management Plan for Fiscal 2026." The Medium-Term Management Plan sets three key points: "deepening" through market expansion and value creation in the city gas and LPG businesses, "exploring" through expansion of the electricity business and new innovation, and "strengthening" the management base. It states that the company will work on proposing integrated energy services including electricity, expanding the supply area of "Kono Machi Denki," developing renewable energy power sources, promoting DX and securing human capital. The company is also advancing efforts toward realizing carbon neutrality by 2050.
